title: Et Tu, Bob?
story: Bob used a Caesar cipher for his exit interview feedback.
Decode his message so we can properly ignore it.
objective: Decode the message using the caesar command.
hints: The 'caesar' command requires a shift amount. You might have to brute force it (try shifts 1 through 25), or write a loop... wait, you don't have loops in this shell. Just guess! It's shift 7.
